summary: Northeast Colorado blizzard: Colorado 4x4 Rescue & Recovery, requested by the Morgan County Undersheriff, ran 60 rescue calls over 5 operational periods (~24 hours) across Weld, Logan, Sedgwick, Morgan, and Washington counties with 24 personnel/9 teams, pulling stranded motorists from 50+ mph ground-blizzard conditions (5-15 ft drifts along the I-76 corridor) to warming shelters; abandoned vehicles checked/flagged for occupants; redeployed Friday evening into Logan County for additional stranded-motorist rescues.
responding_agency: Colorado 4x4 Rescue and Recovery (requested by Morgan County Undersheriff)
notes: Victim count = 60 documented rescue calls, 1-4 occupants each (actual persons >=60). Operation spanned Mon 2022-12-12 (request) through Sat 2022-12-17 (second deployment); main push Tue 12/13-Wed 12/14. Counties served: Weld, Logan, Sedgwick, Morgan, Washington. In scope per id-3369/3345 mass vehicle-assist precedent.
